definitions.explanation: Used when someone cries or sheds tears, whether from sadness, pain, joy, or other strong emotions.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{泣|な}いています。
{映画|えいが}を{見|み}て{泣|な}きました。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xが{泣|な}く (X cries).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {泣|な}いている = 'is crying.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{泣|な}いている (is crying)
・{泣|な}かないで (don't cry)
・{泣|な}き{出|だ}す (burst into tears)
・{嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き (tears of joy)

Kanji {泣|な}く contains water radical (氵). Different from {鳴|な}く (animal sounds) - homophones with different kanji.
